schedules.area_note: All households south of Church Street; entire Church Street; all households east of Main Street
All households north of Church Street and west of Main Street; entire Main Street up to Church Street

schedules.week_pattern: one bulk item per household garbage pickup day
schedules.area_note: Furniture allowed; construction materials excluded; larger items may need to be cut or broken down

schedules.week_pattern: during months listed on Leaf and Branch Pick Up schedule (schedule not published on municipal Public Works page)
schedules.area_note: Leaves and branches at curb; do not bag leaves

dropoff.name: Borough Yard
dropoff.hours: Winter: Monday–Saturday 7:30 a.m.–3:00 p.m.; Summer: Monday–Saturday 7:30 a.m.–2:30 p.m.; closed Sunday and holidays

dropoff.name: Recycling Center
dropoff.hours: Monday–Friday 7:30 a.m.–2:30 p.m.; Saturday 8:00 a.m.–2:00 p.m.; closed Sunday and holidays

keansburg.notes: Two 30-gallon cans (50 lb max each) per pickup; summary line also references two 33-gallon cans and one bulk item. No curbside collection Thanksgiving, Christmas, or New Year's Day. Garbage contractor name not published. Bulk items not accepted at Recycling Center; metals, appliances, and electronics accepted at Borough Yard (some curbside fees apply). Leaf/branch calendar referenced but not posted on fetched Public Works page.

keyport.name: Keyport

schedules.area_note: Sections 1 and 2: Apr 15, May 6, Jun 10, Sep 16, Oct 14, Nov 12 (Veterans Day moved from Nov 11), Dec 9. Sections 3 and 4: Apr 22, May 13, Jun 17, Sep 23, Oct 21, Nov 18, Dec 16. Leaf and branches may also be dropped off at Recycling Center Saturdays 9:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m.

schedules.week_pattern: call 732-739-5136 to schedule curbside pickup before placing at curb
schedules.area_note: Electronic and metal recycling (computers, monitors, televisions, phones, washers, dryers, stoves, bicycles, fencing, bed frames, etc.); permit required for air conditioning or refrigeration units from Municipal Clerk

dropoff.name: Keyport Recycling Center
dropoff.hours: Saturdays 9:00 a.m.–12:00 noon (except holidays); drop-off of recyclables and pick-up of leaf bags

keyport.notes: Containers max 50 gallons and 50 lb when loaded; place curbside night before (ordinance: not before 4:00 p.m. day before). Single-family limit 3 garbage cans; multifamily 6; commercial 4. No garbage/recycling pickup New Year's Day, Christmas Day, or Thanksgiving Day (following day when weather permits). Inclement weather: collection next day. Bulk collection schedule referenced on 2026 map PDF but specific bulk days not published on fetched recycling page. Grass clippings not accepted.

little-silver.name: Little Silver

schedules.week_pattern: second trash pickup of the week (Thursday for Zone 1, Friday for Zone 2); max 3 items
schedules.area_note: Furniture and carpeting; no appliances, electronics, or construction material

schedules.week_pattern: brush curbside pickup continuously January through October
schedules.area_note: Branches max 4 feet length and 12 inches diameter; no grass clippings; bamboo not collected

schedules.week_pattern: leaves curbside pickup November 2 through December 27
schedules.area_note: Leaves only; do not mix brush and leaves

schedules.week_pattern: drop-off at Public Works Yard only (not curbside)
schedules.area_note: Electronics accepted in designated green container: TVs, computers, printers, phones, microwaves, air conditioners, and related items

dropoff.name: Borough Recycling Center / Public Works Yard
dropoff.hours: Monday–Friday 8:00 a.m.–2:00 p.m.; Saturday 8:00 a.m.–12:00 noon; closed Borough holidays

little-silver.notes: Single-stream curbside recycling every other Wednesday by zone; place receptacles night before (max 45 gallons, 50 lb). No trash or recycling curbside collection Thanksgiving, Christmas, or New Year's Day. Recycling questions: Sharon Kavendek, 732-842-2400. Yard no longer accepts motor oil, antifreeze, or paint; electronics drop-off per Aug 2026 alert (2026 Recycling Update still lists arranging private disposal for TVs/computers—alert is newer).
